answer.explanation: The live TABLE_NAME environment variable of CrudApiFunction is 'missing-table'. The IaC template sets TABLE_NAME to the CartTable resource, so the live value has drifted from the intended state. The function was last modified at 22:02:58, just before the window. Every CrudApi error in 22:03-22:13 is an AccessDeniedException on PutItem against table/missing-table. The CrudApiRole policy already grants PutItem on CartTable, so the IAM error is a symptom of the wrong table name, not a missing permission. The IAM layer is not the root cause.
